mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates an ultra-easy monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed risk premia.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases cost of capital and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 15000) combined with moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 240) indicates a sustainable economic expansion without overheating, supporting positive equity returns through stable corporate earnings growth over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting both GDPC1 > 15000 and CPIAUCSL < 240.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) combined with weak labor force participation (PAYEMS < 140000) indicates deteriorating economic conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting both UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS < 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 105 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity that drives corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1050 (thousands of units) indicates strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and retail sales, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) with declining employment (PAYEMS < 140000) signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting both UNRATE > 5.5 and PAYEMS < 140000.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales of services exceeding 450000 (millions of dollars) indicates robust consumer spending in the service sector, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450000.
